issues.description: Older same-rank records can overwrite newer terminal or running job state, timing, and exit-code data during re-ingest.
Rows with empty user/partition and negative AllocCPUS or GPU counts are accepted, allowing invalid data to corrupt reports.
Report filters compare timestamp strings lexicographically, which is wrong for mixed timezone-offset ISO values and silently drops rows with no reference time.
Elapsed-time validation rejects some long-hour forms while accepting nonsensical day-plus-99-hour values.
Report commands create a new empty database for missing or mistyped DB paths instead of failing clearly.
The schema has no indexes for reference-time report filters, so report queries will degrade as the jobs table grows.
